claims.claim: Implemented bounded Operational Receipt v2 projections for PRIMARY, REMEDIATION, and REPAIR carriers/self-hosted workflows, including stable pre-AIOS failure reasons and exact Admission Failure/Correction Preflight cause reuse.
RUN attribution now derives only from exact family dispatch-journal bindings, and attributed canonical terminals reduce to bounded RESULT/FAILURE pointers without copying lifecycle payloads.
Unified Human Surface preserves exact newly produced typed admission causes for delegated PRIMARY, REMEDIATION, and REPAIR failures, retaining DELEGATED_OPERATION_FAILED only as fallback.

Carrier wording distinguishes dispatch-request acceptance, self-host completion, and downstream failure while preserving existing family selectors, journals, command surfaces, and authority boundaries.
